# School Club - AI Based Complete School ERP

School Club is India's most trusted and advanced School Management System (ERP). 
It is designed to digitally transform educational institutions including K-12 schools, CBSE schools, ICSE schools, and colleges across India.

## Key Features & Modules
- Academic ERP: Attendance, Timetable, Exams, Custom Report Cards.
- Fee & Finance: Automated fee collection, reminders, online payment gateway (UPI/Cards).
- Student Information System: Secure profiles, medical records, parent info.
- Transport & GPS: Live bus tracking, automated routing, SMS alerts.
- HR & Payroll: Staff attendance, leaves, compliant payroll processing.
- Parent-Teacher App: Dedicated Mobile app for homework, events, and instant notifications.
